name: LODTree Construction
definition: A multidimensional (multikey) data structure used for fast search of voxel data based on three keys: minimum value, maximum value, and level-of-detail (LOD) of the virtual voxel. It partitions data using a divide-and-conquer approach to create a 3D binary tree where each branch represents a new dimension.
summary: LODTree Construction is a parallel divide-and-conquer algorithm that builds a multidimensional search tree for voxel data, optimizing for parallel file creation and compact storage via bit-mapped vertex coordinates.
